rows.description: Normal-size text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (WCAG 1.4.3, Level AA).
rows.remediation_guidance: Darken failing text colours until they reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the page background. Applied automatically by contrast_fixer during post-processing.

rows.description: Large text (>= 18 pt, or >= 14 pt bold) must have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against its background (WCAG 1.4.3, Level AA).
rows.remediation_guidance: Darken failing large-text colours until they reach at least 3:1 contrast. Applied automatically by contrast_fixer during post-processing.
